description_en: Adds a new sub-scene under a specified main scene
description_zh: 在指定的主场景下添加新的子场景
kebab_example: aliyun tdsr add-sub-scene --scene-id 12340000 --name '子场景A' --upload-type IMAGE --region cn-hangzhou
name: AddSubScene

parameters.help_en: The name of the sub-scene. The name must be 1 to 20 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 子场景名称（长度为1~20个字符）
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en:
The upload type. Valid values:
IMAGE: image
VIDEO: video
parameters.help_zh: 上传类型 图片：IMAGE 视频：VIDEO
parameters.name: upload_type
